punchline: Nir Eyal thought he shared the housework fairly until he and his wife wrote their chores down side by side.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal and his wife kept arguing about chores, and too many evenings ended in late dinners and tears. On a date day they each listed every household task they did. Hers seemed endless. They split the jobs and put each one on the calendar with a time. That's the core of Indistractable: if it has no time, you can't even tell when you've been pulled away from it.
